let keypress_listener (c : char) (action : unit -> unit) : event_listener =
  fun (g : Gctx.gctx) (e : Gctx.event) ->
    begin match Gctx.event_type e with
    | Gctx.KeyPress k -> if k = c then action ()
    | _ -> ()
    end

(* Point on the radius-150 circle centered at (200, 200) for an hour 0..12. *)
let find_endpoint (time : int) : Gctx.position =
  let angle = float_of_int (time mod 12) *. Float.pi /. 6. in
  (200 + int_of_float (Float.round (150. *. sin angle)),
   200 - int_of_float (Float.round (150. *. cos angle)))

let make_game (init_pos : int) : widget =
  let pos = {contents = init_pos} in
  let circle_drawing (g : Gctx.gctx) : unit =
    Gctx.draw_ellipse g (pos.contents, 10) 5 5 in
  let board, canvas_nc = canvas (100, 20) circle_drawing in
  let left_w, left_lc, left_nc = button "Left" in
  let left () =
    pos.contents <- max (pos.contents - 1) 5 in
  left_nc.add_event_listener (mouseclick_listener left);
  (* line 10, omitted on the exam: the Right button *)
  let right_w, right_lc, right_nc = button "Right" in
  let right () =
    pos.contents <- min (pos.contents + 1) 95 in
  right_nc.add_event_listener (mouseclick_listener right);
  let full_game = hlist [board; border left_w; border right_w] in
  border full_game
